channels.name: ANT
channels.purpose: 2.4 GHz antenna interface; single-ended or differential depending on radio architecture.
channels.active_levels: 50 Ω typical impedance; GFSK modulated 1 / 2 MHz wide channels.

global_signals.name: Active_Clock
global_signals.purpose: Active clock for radio + baseband; tolerance ±50 ppm.

global_signals.name: Sleep_Clock
global_signals.purpose: Sleep clock for deep-sleep wake-up; 21..500 ppm SCA options.

handshake_pairs.name: ADV_IND-CONNECT_IND
handshake_pairs.rule: Advertiser broadcasts ADV_IND; initiator responds with CONNECT_IND to start a connection.

handshake_pairs.name: ADV_IND-SCAN_REQ-SCAN_RSP
handshake_pairs.rule: Advertiser broadcasts ADV_IND; active scanner sends SCAN_REQ; advertiser responds with SCAN_RSP.

handshake_pairs.name: LL_DATA-(SN/NESN)
handshake_pairs.rule: Receiver toggles NESN on success; transmitter retransmits same SN on CRC fail.

handshake_pairs.name: LL_ENC_REQ-LL_ENC_RSP
handshake_pairs.rule: Encryption setup; Peripheral provides SKDs + IVs.

handshake_pairs.name: LL_START_ENC_REQ-LL_START_ENC_RSP
handshake_pairs.rule: First encrypted PDU; both ends switch to AES-CCM.

handshake_pairs.name: LL_PHY_REQ-LL_PHY_RSP-LL_PHY_UPDATE_IND
handshake_pairs.rule: PHY Update negotiation; Central drives Instant + final TX/RX PHY.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Central initiates every connection event; Peripheral schedules its receiver around the anchor + window-widening based on its sleep-clock SCA.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Each LL Data PDU carries SN + NESN; receiver toggles NESN on successful CRC + matched expected SN. Empty PDU closes a connection event when both ends have MD=0.

channels_serial_side.name: SIN
channels_serial_side.purpose: Serial data input from peripheral or modem; idle HIGH; receiver samples mid-bit.

channels_serial_side.name: SOUT
channels_serial_side.purpose: Serial data output to peripheral or modem; idle HIGH (mark).

channels_modem_handshake.name: CTS
channels_modem_handshake.purpose: Clear To Send (active LOW); modem status; software interprets, not gating TX hardware.

channels_modem_handshake.name: RTS
channels_modem_handshake.purpose: Request To Send (active LOW); driven by MCR.1.

channels_modem_handshake.name: DSR
channels_modem_handshake.purpose: Data Set Ready (active LOW); modem status.

channels_modem_handshake.name: DTR
channels_modem_handshake.purpose: Data Terminal Ready (active LOW); driven by MCR.0.

channels_modem_handshake.name: DCD
channels_modem_handshake.purpose: Data Carrier Detect (active LOW); modem status.

channels_modem_handshake.name: OUT1
channels_modem_handshake.purpose: User-defined output (active LOW); driven by MCR.2.

channels_modem_handshake.name: OUT2
channels_modem_handshake.purpose: User-defined output (active LOW); driven by MCR.3.

channels_dma_handshake.name: TXRDY
channels_dma_handshake.purpose: TX FIFO/THR ready; Mode 0 = THR empty; Mode 1 = FIFO empty (selected by FCR.3).

channels_dma_handshake.name: RXRDY
channels_dma_handshake.purpose: RX FIFO/RBR has data; Mode 0 = data available; Mode 1 = FIFO at trigger level.

channels_cpu_bus.name: RD
channels_cpu_bus.purpose: Read strobe (either RD HIGH or RD LOW with CS active enables read).

channels_cpu_bus.name: ADS
channels_cpu_bus.purpose: Address strobe; positive edge latches A0-A2 + CS0-CS2; tie LOW if unused.

channels_cpu_bus.name: DDIS
channels_cpu_bus.purpose: Driver Disable; LOW while CPU reads UART (for external bus transceiver).

channels_clock_reset.name: XOUT
channels_clock_reset.purpose: Crystal feedback inverter output; unused if external clock applied.

channels_clock_reset.name: BAUDOUT
channels_clock_reset.purpose: 16× baud-rate clock; tie to RCLK or external use.

ordering_rules.register_ordering: DLAB must be set/cleared correctly to select between (RBR/THR/IER) and (DLL/DLM) views.
ordering_rules.bit_order_within_byte: LSB-first on the wire after whitening.
ordering_rules.byte_order_within_field: Little-endian for multi-byte fields (Access Address, Connection Interval, Timeout, ChM, etc.).
ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: Half-duplex; T_IFS = 150 µs between TX and RX in connection events.
ordering_rules.preamble_first_then_AA_then_PDU_then_CRC: Always in this order; whitening starts at PDU header (Preamble + Access Address are not whitened).

logical_signaling_levels.name: SE0
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Single-Ended Zero; used for EOP + Reset + disconnect

channels_bus_side_2_wire.name: A (non-inverting)
channels_bus_side_2_wire.purpose: Non-inverting differential bus line; when transmitting mark, A is the more positive line of the pair.
channels_bus_side_2_wire.active_levels: V_A - V_B > +200 mV at receiver → mark; V_A - V_B < -200 mV → space

channels_bus_side_2_wire.name: B (inverting)
channels_bus_side_2_wire.purpose: Inverting differential bus line; complementary to A.

channels_host_side.name: D / DI
channels_host_side.purpose: Driver input from host UART TX; logic level.

channels_host_side.name: DE
channels_host_side.purpose: Driver Enable (active HIGH); when LOW, driver tri-stated.

channels_host_side.name: RE# (RE)
channels_host_side.purpose: Receiver Enable (active LOW); when HIGH, receiver output tri-stated.

channels_host_side.name: R / RO
channels_host_side.purpose: Receiver output to host UART RX; logic level.

logical_signal_states.name: loss-of-signal (LOS)
logical_signal_states.value: |V_AB| < 200 mV; receiver R indeterminate unless failsafe-biased

bus_field_segments.name: IDLE_BIASED
bus_field_segments.form: Driver tri-stated; failsafe holds V_AB > +200 mV

bus_field_segments.name: DE_GUARD_BAND
bus_field_segments.form: Software-controlled blank time between DE deassert and DE reassert

logical_rf_channels.name: Data 0..36
logical_rf_channels.purpose: Data channels — used in connection events + Periodic Advertising + Isochronous Channels
